newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end up in volume trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end up in volume trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed up on high volumes as foreigners picked blue chips, brokers said.
The all-share index closed 2.16 points higher at 630.80. Blue chips Development Finance rose 4.75 rupees to 290, Commercial Bank 5.50 to 125.50.
"The banking sector, fuelled by growth in manufacturing stocks, should do well," said Derendra Abayaratna, fund manager at Ceybank Unit Trust.
There are many undervalued stocks in the banking and finance sector, which will be the ultimate beneficiary from last week's investment-oriented budget for 1997, he said.
